keyTips.text: After a few levels, spend ranged and melee stances on extended trades the lane allows.
At level 6, respect gaining no ultimate rank while most top laners spike; space and harass from range instead of forcing it.
Fire E then Q from fog before fights to bank the team an early advantage.

tips.text: Hold Q poke up and weave autos as opponents step in for last-hits.
Lower opponents with E then Q poke before attempting an all-in finish.
Treat the first item component as an early damage spike, threatening short burst after landed E then Q poke.
Delay full fights while Q softens opponents first.
Farm sides and nearby towers first, joining teamfights only with no close tower to take.
Duel anyone contesting the side push with strong dueling.
At level 9, raise poke damage with maxed Q and set fog E then Q traps for unsuspecting squishies.
Stay with the team late so enemies isolate neither Jayce nor a 4v5 opening.
While weak, peel for carries on the nearest enemy; while ahead, flank for the backline.
Spread poke across as many enemies as positioning permits with pre-fight E then Q.

itemization.text: Track rising poke strength with item components while watching mana needs.
